## A plain slide

Each `##` heading starts a new slide. Body text is ordinary markdown.

- Bullets work as expected
- **Bold**, *italic*, `code`
- Keep to ~5 bullets; the font is sized for a room, not a monitor

## Math is real LaTeX

Inline like $\mathbb{E}[x_0 \mid x_\sigma]$, and display like

$$p_\sigma(x) = \tfrac12 \mathcal{N}(x; -1, \sigma^2) + \tfrac12 \mathcal{N}(x; +1, \sigma^2)$$

Rendered to MathML at build time, so it needs no network in the classroom.

## Callout box

::: {.note}
`::: {.note}` gives the pale-blue box with the dark left rule. Use it for the
one thing you want them to leave with.
:::

## Emphasis line

Wrap a sentence in `[...]{.big}` to get the large blue emphasis text:

[The whole pipeline: noise the data → learn to denoise → run it backwards.]{.big}

To centre it, put it inside a centred div:

::: {style="text-align:center"}
[Centred and large.]{.big}
:::

## Tables

| Family | Support | Knobs |
|---|---|---|
| $\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^2)$ | $\mathbb{R}$ | center, width |
| $\mathrm{Beta}(\alpha,\beta)$ | $(0,1)$ | two shapes |

Header row is blue, even rows are tinted — automatic.

## An image

Paths are relative to this `slides/` folder, and the image is embedded into the
output file:

```markdown
![](../materials/img/astronaut-sdxl.jpg){width="100%"}
```

## An embedded demo

The deck is built into `../materials/`, so an iframe path is relative to *that*
folder — no `../`:

````markdown
```{=html}
<iframe src="two-point-diffusion-demo.html" style="width:100%;height:60%;border:1px solid #cfdcec;border-radius:8px" loading="lazy" title="Demo"></iframe>
```
````

## Reveal extras

::: {.fragment}
This line appears on the next keypress — wrap anything in `::: {.fragment}`.
:::

::: {.notes}
Speaker notes. Press **S** during the talk for the presenter view with these,
a timer, and the next slide.
:::

Press **O** for the slide overview, **F** for fullscreen, **E** for print/PDF view.
